description.text: Core courses Management, Microeconomics, Macroeconomics, Operations Research, Management Information System, Management Statistics, Information Resource Management, Information Network Analysis and Design, Data Structure and Database and Computer Network. Objective This objective is to train students to be applied talents to do information system development, information management and consultation in enterprises and institutions of various types. This objective is to train students to be innovative talents who have the solid foundation of management; have acquaintance with the basic theory of modern management, economics and the science of information; skillfully grasp the analytical methods of information system. Meanwhile, they have relatively wide knowledge, strong scientific research ability, initiative spirit and practice capability. Schooling Length In standards it lasts four years. The minimum of schooling length must be three years and its extension lasts no more than seven years. Credits The minimum of 170 credits must be obtained for graduation. Diploma Bachelor of Management is granted.

duration.text: The Information management and information system at Sichuan Normal University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2083 USD/per year ￥ 15000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) 6. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 7.Certification of no criminal record 8.Copy of insurance policy 9.Photocopies of personal artwork Those who apply for artistic major should supply materials to prove your art level.

requirements.text: 1.High school graduates 2.No criminal record 3.HSK level 3 or above
